Interpretation: Highest burden; not a LISA hotspot

Ward: Spatial weights: k=5 nearest neighbours (Haversine km), inverse-distance among those neighbours, row-standardized. Local Moran's I from 999 conditional permutations; site-wise p<0.05 labelled strong. No false-discovery correction is applied across the 58 local tests; classifications are exploratory. Ajmal Khan Road Market is a marginal high–high cluster (p=0.066) and is not treated as confirmed. High-burden GREEN sites without a LISA label are isolated generators, not hotspots. Method follows ward-level MSW hotspot analysis in Kumar, Choudhary and Mathur (2026), adapted to locality plastic burden. Delhi NCT sample only.
